skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to effectively use statistical software such as SPSS, Stata, Minitab, SAS, Epidata, and R.

Understanding and applying various methods of data analysis including descriptive statistics, estimation, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, forecasting, variance analysis, factor analysis, and time series analysis.
Basic understanding of statistical theory and its application in real-world scenarios.
Proficiency in using Excel for basic statistical analysis.
